why_choose_us.title: Licensed Electricians Trained For Home Safety
why_choose_us.description: Every electrician on our team is licensed and trained specifically to spot the hazards a homeowner or building manager would never notice on their own.

why_choose_us.title: Emergency Services Available
why_choose_us.description: Standard hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00am to 3:30pm — but an electrical emergency doesn't wait for business hours, so we don't either.

why_choose_us.title: Serving All Of Northeastern Pennsylvania
why_choose_us.description: Based in Dupont, we serve homeowners, businesses and contractors across the greater NEPA area — Pittston, Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Kingston, Clarks Summit and the towns between them.

why_choose_us.title: Quick, On-Time Service
why_choose_us.description: Customers choose us for our knowledge and expertise, but they stay with us for our quick, on-time service and the level of care we bring to every job.

services_section.subtitle: Residential, commercial/industrial and low voltage electrical services for homes and businesses across Northeastern Pennsylvania.

closing_cta.headline: Need An Electrician?
closing_cta.body: Call 570-472-3300 or send us the details of the job. We serve Dupont and the greater Northeastern Pennsylvania area, with emergency service available outside our normal Monday–Friday, 7:00am–3:30pm hours.

blog_section.heading: Electrical Advice For NEPA Homes & Businesses
blog_section.description: Straight answers about home and commercial electrical work in Northeastern Pennsylvania — panel upgrades, safety inspections, and when to call an electrician instead of waiting.
